modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Hello there everyone, hope you have a great weekend 😉Finally found some time for a post, so here is a Kling 4.0 video, you can find the prompt below as usual https://t.co/ORbCFIL29S

originalPrompt: On a mysterious alien planet beneath two enormous glowing suns, a female astronaut cautiously approaches a tall biomechanical alien being. The alien slowly raises one hand toward her helmet, but suddenly both characters react as the ground violently trembles. The astronaut loses balance and catches herself while the alien turns rapidly toward the horizon. Strange flying creatures burst from the distant valley. The alien grabs the astronaut and pulls her behind a rock formation as energy projectiles streak overhead. She draws a compact futuristic weapon while the alien extends its arms and generates a shimmering defensive field. The camera circles around both characters continuously, switching from intimate close-ups to fast tracking shots, realistic body reactions, moving helmet reflections, atmospheric particles, strong wind, fluid character interaction, cinematic first-contact action.
